name: After recital D
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: Db. whereas France is one of the main net contributors to the EU budget; whereas, in that capacity, the preparation of the 2028-2034 MFF should not be undertaken in a hasty manner without the close involvement of the President of the French Republic elected in the May 2027 elections, whose political and budgetary priorities are expected to differ from those of the current president;
